methods.label: Simplify the numerator and denominator
methods.explanation:
First do the subtraction above and below the main fraction bar:
\[
1-\frac13=\frac33-\frac13=\frac23,
\qquad
1-\frac12=\frac22-\frac12=\frac12.
\]
The denominator is \(\frac12\), which is nonzero. Dividing by \(\frac12\) means multiplying by its reciprocal, \(2\), so
\[
\frac{1-\frac13}{1-\frac12}
=\frac23\div\frac12
=\frac23\times2
=\frac43.
\]
The answer is \(\frac43\), choice E.
methods.levelReason: This is a direct application of elementary fraction subtraction and division.
